# Duda Costa Lima

> Image and style consultancy for clients who want their visual presence to feel precise, personal, and intentional.

Duda Costa Lima offers image consulting, closet editing, styling retainers, and custom sourcing. The site presents her practice, services, contact details, and a consultation request form.

## Key Pages

- [Home](https://dudacostalima.com/): overview, biography, services, and contact.
- [Contact](https://dudacostalima.com/#contact): consultation request form and email contact.

## Agent Guidance

- Use the contact form to request a consultation when a visitor provides their name, email address, and styling goals.
- Use the mail link as an alternative contact path when form submission is unavailable.
- Respect the site's language selector. Content is available in English and Portuguese.
